fusions.name: Witchbane Ball
fusions.desc: Fires a cold-iron ball that deals 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 10 tiles, ignoring the target's resistances, with a 30% chance to leave it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Grapeshot
fusions.desc: Fires a cone of iron grapeshot, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it, with a 20% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pavise Screen
fusions.desc: Sets up an iron screen 4 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds that blocks enemies and their shots.

fusions.name: Cool Bore
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
